scope.statement: Independent destination review of GLOBAL-LEVEL-I-ONE-CONTACT-PR955 at commit 7d0a450fe66991036541023f95c44c064a04b6a8.
scope.domain: Exact rational spot controls for the pinch-dilate map on a square and the unique-contact contraction on a three-point source; the universal proof and external D(8) premise are analyzed in README.md.
scope.limitations: Finite exact controls do not prove the universal analytic statements or Level I. The n=8 regression is conditional on the cited Bezdek-Fodor D(8) value.

result: The analytic one-contact arguments and their stated fixed-cardinality consequences have no identified defect; finite exact spot controls pass. No theorem promotion or Level I closure is claimed.
remaining_questions: Prove that for every sufficiently large n the triangle-free unit-separated n-point class does not attain D(n), or construct triangle-free global minimizers for arbitrarily large n.
